title: Pure Cicada
summary: Cicada is a Level 3 Insect Xyz swarm engine centered around Dream Cicada, Transcicada, and Number 3: Cicada King. By changing battle positions to trigger Dream Cicada's Special Summon condition and pairing with Lv3 Insect extenders like Digital Bugs and Gokipole, the deck rapidly fields multiple copies of Number 3: Cicada King for monster negation and Insect revival.

allow.Digital Bug Websolder: Level 3 Insect that changes a monster to Defense Position to Special Summon a Level 3 Insect from hand.
allow.Digital Bug Cocoondenser: Level 3 Insect that revives a Level 3 Insect in Defense Position on Normal Summon.
allow.Digital Bug Centibit: Level 3 Insect that summons a Level 3 Insect from the Deck when switched from Attack to Defense Position.
allow.Gokipole: Level 3 EARTH Insect that searches a Level 4 Insect when sent to the GY and serves as a Level 3 Xyz material for Cicada King.
allow.Bug Signal: Quick-Play Rank-Up Spell that upgrades Rank 3 Number 3: Cicada King into Rank 5 Digital Bug Corebage.
allow.Bug Emergency: Trap that revives 2 Level 3 Insect monsters from the GY to immediately Xyz Summon Number 3: Cicada King.
allow.Worm Bait: Summons 2 Insect Tokens while you control an Insect to link into Inzektor Picofalena.
allow.Digital Bug Scaradiator: Rank 3 Insect Xyz that negates an opponent's monster and changes its battle position.
allow.Digital Bug Corebage: Rank 5 Insect Xyz that ranks up over Cicada King or Scaradiator and spins Defense Position monsters into the Deck.
allow.Digital Bug Rhinosebus: Rank 7 Insect Xyz that ranks up over Corebage with Quick Effect monster destruction.
allow.Inzektor Picofalena: Link-2 Insect that equips Gokipole from the Deck and recycles GY Insects.

main: Dream Cicada
Signature Level 3 Insect that Special Summons itself from the hand if you control an Attack Position Insect and switches a monster on the field to Defense Position.
Transcicada
Level 3 Insect Tuner that Special Summons a Cicada Token to provide an immediate body for Link or Rank 3 Xyz plays.
Oily Cicada
Level 3 Insect that changes battle positions and reduces monster Levels to enable flexible Xyz plays.
Digital Bug Websolder
Changes a face-up monster you control to Defense Position to Special Summon a Level 3 Insect from hand.
Digital Bug Cocoondenser
Revives Dream Cicada or Gokipole in Defense Position upon Normal Summon for an instant Rank 3 Cicada King.
Digital Bug Centibit
Summons Dream Cicada or Gokipole directly from the Deck when switched from Attack to Defense Position.
Gokipole
Level 3 Insect Xyz material that searches another Level 4 Insect when detached from Cicada King or sent to the GY.
Bug Signal
Quick-Play Spell that ranks up Number 3: Cicada King into Digital Bug Corebage.
Bug Emergency
Revives 2 Level 3 Insects from the GY to assemble another Number 3: Cicada King.
Worm Bait
Summons 2 Insect Tokens while you control an Insect to link into Inzektor Picofalena.
extra: Signature Rank 3 Xyz boss that revives an Insect when switched to Defense Position and detaches 1 material as a Quick Effect to negate a monster's effects and boost DEF.
Rank 3 Insect Xyz that detaches 2 materials to negate an opponent's monster and force it into Defense Position.
Rank 5 Insect Xyz that ranks up over Cicada King and shuffles Defense Position monsters into the Deck.
Rank 7 Insect Xyz that ranks up over Corebage and detaches a material to destroy the opponent's highest-DEF monster(s).
Equips Gokipole from the Deck to search Dream Cicada or Cocoondenser.
